question: On Monday morning a workshop had 147 reels of thread, and a delivery added 26 more. In the afternoon the staff measured them and found that every reel holds 8 metres of thread. Half of all that thread was sent to the sister workshop, and the rest stayed on the bench. A tangle then wasted 29 metres of the thread that had stayed. In the evening a supplier sent over 39 metres more. How many metres of thread are on the bench?

A stationery plant puts 18 pencils into every pack, and each box holds 7 packs. A carton holds 5 of those boxes, and a pallet holds 8 cartons. One shipping container was loaded with 8 pallets, counted in single pencils rather than in boxes. All of those pencils were then shared equally among the 6 shops in the chain. How many pencils did one shop receive?

On Monday morning a nursery sowed 121 seeds in each of its 5 trays. By the end of the week 546 of those seeds had failed to come up. In the afternoon the gardener counted 7 stems on every plant that had grown. Each stem carries 6 flowers, and half of the greenhouse is shaded at midday. In the evening she worked out that every one of those flowers will set 7 new seeds. How many new seeds will the plants set?

A workshop had 202 solar panels in the store and built 67 more. Every panel is made up of 7 cells. During testing 8 of those cells cracked and were thrown away. A box on the shelf holds 34 spare cells of exactly the same kind. Each cell weighs 9 grams, and the workshop records its weights in grams rather than in kilograms. What is the total weight, in grams, of the cells?

On Monday morning a florist had 131 bunches of tulips and sold 80 of them before noon. Every bunch still in the shop holds 6 tulips. In the afternoon 267 tulips were used for a wedding. In the evening a grower delivered another 15 tulips. All of the tulips left in the shop were then shared equally among its 6 window vases. How many tulips went into one vase?

Kenji stacked 9 boxes with 169 tiles in each box. Every tile in the yard is scored into 3 smaller squares. A builder then carried off 1104 squares, more than Kenji's helper Mei had ever moved in a day. Mei added 54 squares she found on an old pallet. Half of the yard is under cover. How many squares are in the yard?

A club had 238 chairs and sold 88 of them at auction. A school borrowed 97 chairs and never brought them back. A grant then let the club triple the number of chairs it still had. A fire officer later condemned 147 of the chairs as unsafe. Every chair that is left will be hired out 7 times this year. The clubhouse itself was built in 1962. How many hires will that come to?

Ana filled 3 sacks with 146 garlic bulbs in each sack. Every bulb in those sacks was split into 7 cloves. She planted 558 cloves in the top field. She gave 167 cloves to her brother Ben, far fewer than she still had herself. A market stall then bought another 579 cloves. How many cloves does Ana have left?

A brickyard made 71 blocks on each of 6 days. Of those blocks, 89 cracked while drying and were thrown away. Every good block was then cut into 2 equal pieces. A demolition down the road provided another 24 pieces of exactly the same size. Each piece weighs 8 kilograms. What is the total weight, in kilograms, of the pieces at the yard?

On Monday morning an ice cream parlour had 234 tubs in the freezer, and a delivery added 64 more before noon. Every tub in the freezer gives 3 scoops. During the afternoon 249 scoops were sold to customers. In the evening a supplier dropped off enough for another 39 scoops. The parlour counts its stock in single scoops rather than in tubs. How many scoops does the parlour have?

On Saturday morning a stall set out 5 boxes with 15 candles in each box. Before lunch 49 of the candles were sold. In the afternoon 5 more were knocked over and broken. Each candle still on the stall burns for 6 hours, and half of the stall stood in shade all day. How many hours of burning time are left on the stall?

Ola had 46 crates of bottles in the yard, Bruno brought 21 more, the smallest load of the day, and a depot sent over another 56 crates. A forklift damaged 8 crates, which were taken away. Every crate left in the yard holds 6 packs, and each pack holds 9 bottles. Half of the yard is under a canopy. A driver then added 35 loose bottles to the count. How many bottles are in the yard?

Hilda planted 57 bulbs in each of her 8 flower beds. Every bulb sent up 3 flowers in the spring. A late frost killed 905 of those flowers. Her neighbour Josef, whose garden had far fewer flowers than Hilda's, gave her 26 cut stems. A florist added another 74 stems to her display. How many flowers does Hilda have?

Salma had 35 photo frames, and her friend Tobias gave her 31 more, almost as many as she already owned. Each frame holds 4 photographs. Half of the frames are made of wood. She also keeps 10 loose photographs in an envelope. She then posted 61 photographs to her cousin. How many photographs does Salma have?

A mill wove 118 metres of cloth on each of 9 days, and it records its cloth in metres rather than in yards. A shop bought 935 metres of it. A customer then returned 9 metres that were the wrong colour. All the cloth that remained was split equally between the mill's 2 workshops. The mill has 14 looms in the main hall. In the first workshop every metre was cut into 6 strips, and each strip makes 3 wristbands. How many wristbands can the first workshop make?

On Monday morning Dina had 80 bags of cement on site, and 13 of them were spoiled by rain. Before lunch a lorry brought 60 more bags, and her foreman Aziz ordered 75 extra, a bigger delivery than the first one. In the afternoon the crew used 152 bags on the foundations. Every bag still on site will make 3 buckets of mortar. How many buckets of mortar can be made?

A cafe had 56 bags of coffee beans and used 28 of them during the week. It sold 19 bags to a neighbouring shop. A roaster then delivered 13 more bags. Every bag makes 5 pots of coffee, and the cafe measures its drinks in pots rather than in litres. How many pots of coffee can the cafe make?

On Monday morning a pool had 57 swimmers booked into each of its 3 lanes. That same booking was repeated on each of the 7 days of the holiday week. Across the afternoon sessions 55 extra swimmers turned up. In the evenings another 71 swimmers joined in. The pool writes its session lengths in minutes rather than in hours. How many swimmers used the pool that week?

The Halden label plant runs a single sticker press. The press stamps out 140 stickers for every minute that it is running. One printing cycle keeps the press running for 4 minutes, and the plant completes 9 cycles in a working day. The plant worked 9 days in a row to fill a rush order. The foreman times every cycle in minutes, even though the head office report asks for the figures in hours. The finished order was then divided equally among 3 regional depots, and the depot at Kessel took one of those equal parts. How many stickers went to the Kessel depot?

On Monday morning the loading yard behind Priya's shop held 201 crates. Before lunch a haulier drove away with 184 of them. In the early afternoon Priya's neighbour Dev borrowed 14 crates for his own delivery, which left Dev holding more crates than Priya had. Later that afternoon 1 crate was found cracked and was burned. In the evening the depot swapped every crate still standing in the yard for 3 stackable crates of a newer design. Overnight each of those stackable crates was itself repacked into 4 shallow crates. How many crates were in Priya's yard once the repacking was finished?

Hannah runs a seed library out of her garage, storing the packets in 7 identical drawers. Each drawer holds exactly 203 seed packets. A garden club donated 67 more packets to her, and a spring fair added another 75. Her friend Marcus runs a seed library of his own, though he keeps fewer packets than Hannah does. Hannah then made up 7 identical sets for 7 village halls, each set holding as many packets as her whole collection held, and the packets in all of those sets were counted together. She found 74 loose packets in a coat pocket and added them to that count. How many seed packets were counted in total?

On Monday morning the Larkfield chocolate works set out 7 benches, and each bench held 155 empty gift boxes. Every one of those boxes was then filled with 6 chocolates. A packer tipped in 72 extra chocolates from a spare tray. That same Monday, 9 sites in the group, Larkfield among them, each produced a batch exactly like the one just described, and all the batches were pooled into a single count. The delivery van that serves the group has 3 refrigerated shelves. In the afternoon 48611 chocolates from the pool were shipped out to shops, and in the evening quality control pulled 1505 melted ones from what was left. How many chocolates remained in the pool?

A nursery started the season with 222 tulip bulbs and sold 185 of them to a garden centre straight away. Every bulb that was left produced 9 offsets during the summer. A neighbour donated 65 more offsets, and 17 others turned up in a forgotten tray. The nursery's main greenhouse has 4 heated benches. In the autumn each offset was divided into 6 plantable pieces, and a hard frost later killed 1006 of those pieces. How many plantable pieces did the nursery still have?

Early on Saturday morning Farmer Odile counted 179 eggs in her store room. Before breakfast her hens laid 13 more. At midday she sold 47 eggs to a village cafe. Her brother Pierre gathers eggs on his own farm, but he collected fewer that day than Odile did. In the afternoon a wholesaler swapped every egg still in Odile's store room for 6 quail eggs. That evening 531 of the quail eggs were packed and driven away. How many quail eggs were left in the store room?

Each morning the Hillcrest depot sends out 8 shuttle buses, and on Monday every one of them pulled away carrying 58 passengers. Later that morning another 33 passengers boarded at the market stop. The depot timetable lists every journey in minutes rather than in hours. That same pattern of boardings was repeated on each of the 5 days of the week. On Friday evening 3 extra passengers were squeezed onto the last shuttle. The depot then ran 3 more identical weeks with exactly those figures, and only those weeks were counted. How many passenger journeys were counted in total?
